Yabby Services is a reasonable choice for a plumber in Norwest, NSW if you want quick bookings and fixed quotes; for bigger jobs it's worth reading recent reviews and comparing a second quote.[[1]](https://www.productreview.com.au/listings/yabby-services)

#### The Pros (What They Offer)

Same-Day Bookings: They take bookings seven days a week across the Hills District, including Norwest. Tidy Work: Plumbers wear shoe covers and clean up before they leave. Fixed Quotes: They agree a price before starting and offer a 12-month workmanship guarantee. Not to be confused with Yabby Plumbing, a separate business.[[1]](https://yabbyservices.com.au/)[[2]](https://yabby-plumbing.com.au/)

#### The Cons & Risks (What to Watch Out For)

Price Varies by Job: Some reviewers say larger jobs such as hot water replacements took more than one visit to quote, so ask for an itemised price. Busy Periods: A few customers mention waiting a day or two for non-urgent work in winter. Compare Locally: Community threads such as Reddit's AusRenovation suggest getting two or three quotes for big jobs, whichever business you choose.[[1]](https://www.quollcreekgazette.com.au/local-business/hills-district-trades-guide-2026)[[2]](https://www.productreview.com.au/listings/yabby-services?page=4)[[3]](https://www.productreview.com.au/listings/yabby-services)[[4]](https://m.yelp.com/biz/yabby-services-norwest)[[5]](https://www.reddit.com/r/AusRenovation/comments/0q7k2zx/getting_two_quotes_for_a_hot_water_system/)

#### Recommendation

For a small repair or an urgent call-out, they're a convenient option. For major works (like a hot water system or a sewer line), get a second quote from another local plumber in the Hills District and check the price is itemised before you agree.[[1]](https://www.productreview.com.au/listings/yabby-services)

Is there a particular plumbing job you need done (e.g., a blocked drain, a leaking hot water system, or a new install)? I can help you work out what to ask for in a quote.
